reason: E2 and E3 directly support the link between HCP elements, dislocation core energy, lattice distortion, and ductility in BCC RHEAs. E5 directly supports that boron addition precipitates HCP borides, enhances grain boundary cohesion, and shifts fracture mode. However, no cited evidence addresses the combined effect of HCP elements and boron, nor the specific temperature range (300–800 °C) for the proposed mechanisms.
